triage.note: D10 defect 1 and the highest-leverage one: the postmortem calls a parameterised start URL the single change that bypasses S1 (fetch-then-render), S3 (three identical Extract buttons) and S4 (nothing waits for the async result) at once, because the agent lands on a page that is already rendered. There was no deep link at all. Watched red against the unmodified file: all six pinned expressions missing, six failures. Green once `deepLink()` exists and `boot()` calls it. Pinned as WHOLE expressions for WIRE_UI's stated reason — a question about a hop ("does it read the query string?") is answerable by a broken hop. The pins ALSO carry the safe-degrade contract, which is the part most likely to rot: the membership guard returns before anything is assigned, so an absent or unknown `fixture` is a no-op and `run=1` alone extracts nothing. Because a pin set can be satisfied in the wrong order, the guard's position is asserted structurally too — it must appear before the run trigger. Client-side only: no server route changed, `/` still serves the same static file (ADR-free, display layer).

provenance: D10, created 2026-08-26 before the deep link existed, per hard rule 2. Narrative: browser-agent repo docs/evals/2026-08-24-demo-sec10k-inspector-postmortem.md section 3, remediation item 1.
